cards.name: steps
cards.title: From Social accounts to **your first update**

steps.title: Social accounts
steps.text: Open it in the right workspace.

steps.title: Right account
steps.text: Pick the one with the owner or manager role.

steps.title: Allow access
steps.text: Let it publish to your profile.

steps.title: Tick locations
steps.text: Only the ones you’ll post to.

items: Check the profile is still verified

good.label: Safe
items: Remove the role when work ends

cards.name: bottom-line
cards.quote: A verified profile, an owner or manager role and **the right Google account.** That’s the whole trick.
cards.by: Check your role first, and connecting takes about five minutes.
